**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

**Apple's diluted EPS for fiscal 2024 (year ended September 28, 2024): $6.08** (down from $6.13 in FY2023; basic EPS $6.11). Note that FY2024 net income of $93.7B was depressed by a one-time, non-cash-ish $10.2B net income tax charge related to the European Commission State Aid Decision (effective tax rate 24.1% vs. 14.7% a year earlier), so underlying earnings power was stronger than the headline EPS suggests.

**Summary:** I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) and checked the live quote (last $222.70, bid $222.68 / ask $222.72). The fundamentals support a modest add: total net sales rose 2% to $391.0B with Services up 13% to $96.2B and total gross margin expanding to 46.2% from 44.1%, operating income up 7.5% to $123.2B, and cash generated by operating activities of $118.3B — funding $95.0B of buybacks and $15.2B of dividends, with $140.8B of unrestricted cash and marketable securities. Diluted EPS of $6.08 was held back mainly by the one-time $10.2B State Aid tax charge rather than operating deterioration, and the 2% revenue growth plus Greater China weakness (-8%) are the main cautions, which is why I sized the position modestly rather than aggressively. Within your mandate (AAPL/MSFT only, buys only, ≤$10,000 per order, ≤$20,000 total today, limit near market, no outflows), I placed one limit order to buy **40 shares of AAPL at $222.75** (≈$8,910, ~0.02% above the $222.72 ask), which filled at $222.75. That leaves roughly $11,090 of today's $20,000 budget unused, and no funds were moved out of the account.
